name: Five-Foot-Way Shophouse
summary: A fictional two-storey KL Rush shophouse with a sheltered pavement, sage awning and plaster facade. Use it as a single storefront, or build a row from the row kit.
notes: The standalone shophouse has an arcade column at each end, matching the game’s runtime columns. It embeds six 1024 × 512 texture maps (JPEG colour and normal, PNG roughness) and uses metres, with its base at ground level and the street side facing +Z.
The row kit holds a column-free module, a single column and a README. Place modules every 5.6 m and one column on each join, so neighbours share a column instead of doubling it.
